Oasis Second Chance Animal Shelter Ltd (OSCAS) is a registered charity devoted to caring for over a hundred rescued stray mixed breeds. These dogs are rescued from industrial estates, parks and urbanisation of jungles to save them from being culled by the local authorities. More than a hundred 'Singapore Specials' call OSCAS their home as they wait for their right families to come along.

Stray rescue in Singapore is a long tiring journey and a never-ending issue. OSCAS was founded by two ladies who have been relying on their life savings to support the dogs. Help is needed for the shelter to continue caring for the dogs.

"Lend a Hand, Save a Paw"
